messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “best” month to visit Hawaii depends on what you’re looking for—weather, crowds, or price—but most travelers agree that **late spring (April–May) and early fall (September–October)** strike the best balance.

| What you want | Why those months work |
|---------------|-----------------------|
| **Mild, pleasant weather** | Average highs range from 78 °F (26 °C) in April to 84 °F (29 °C) in September—comfortably warm but not scorching. |
| **Low rainfall** | Rainfall drops after the summer monsoon season (June–August). April–May and September–October see the least precipitation. |
| **Fewer crowds & better deals** | These shoulder seasons are outside the peak summer and holiday periods, so hotels and flights are cheaper and beaches are less crowded. |
| **Great surf & marine life** | The swell is still good for surfing, and the water is clear enough for snorkeling and diving. |

If you’re a big‑budget traveler who doesn’t mind crowds, **June–July** can also be good because the weather is consistently sunny and the ocean is warm, but expect higher prices and larger crowds. Conversely, **December–March** are the wettest months and can be cooler, though they’re great for whale watching.

So, for a blend of comfortable temperatures, lower prices, and fewer tourists, aim for **April, May, September, or October**.
